title: Only the log's parent was resolved, so a log symlinked to a tracked file was truncated, a linked prompt could lie in the worktree, and the CLI log was unchecked
resolution: scripts/review-files.ts resolves the prompt's real path and each log's real directory, refuses a symbolic link, a hard link, or a non-file log, and opens logs with O_NOFOLLOW; the CLI log is checked too, with regression tests.

title: Node.js added the inherited NODE_V8_COVERAGE to the reviewer despite the explicit environment, and the test exempted it
resolution: The reviewer starts as /usr/bin/env -i with the allowlist, so nothing the runtime adds reaches it; the test sets NODE_V8_COVERAGE and checks the child environment without that exception.

title: OpenCode passed with its model unconfirmed, against the requirement that the expected model is confirmed before the template prints
resolution: The run's events carry no model, so make review reads it from opencode session export of the session; a missing, other, or differently varied model, or a failed export, exits 4.

title: Antigravity accepted any mention of the model ID in its log, and a CLI log left from an earlier attempt
resolution: The CLI log is emptied before each run and only its model override label lines count, each of which must name the row's label; tests for another label, a mere mention, and a stale log.

title: A log that was the prompt file or its alias was truncated before the reviewer read the prompt
resolution: A log with the prompt's device and inode, including the derived CLI log, is refused with exit status 1 before any file is opened for writing; tests for the same path, a hard link, and the CLI log.

title: File and synchronous launch errors were rethrown from runReview, and a failed prompt open leaked the log descriptor
resolution: A missing log directory or a non-file log is refused before routing, file errors become exit status 1, a launch that cannot start exits 4, and nested finally blocks close every opened descriptor; tests.

title: A route.json holding JSON null crashed the route gate and the recommendation with a TypeError
resolution: routeRecord accepts only a JSON object, so another value is a stale route for pass 1 and no recommendation later; tests for null and a malformed plan in passes 1, 2, and 3.

title: The proposal still said that this change's own reviewers run with env -u JEV_MAF_LAB
resolution: The proposal says that passes 1 and 2 of this change run through make review itself.

title: The route recommendation compared full keys, so an effort-only difference printed that another reviewer A goes to the coordinator, also for pass 2
resolution: Harness and model are compared apart from the variant: an effort-only difference prints 'recommends effort X; the authorized Y applies (policy version 7)', and only role A adds the report to the coordinator; tests for a match, an effort, and another A and B.

title: A failed attempt lost the gate, recommendation, invocation, and environment lines, because stdout was built only after the reviewer exited
resolution: Lines go to a print dependency when they are known; the gate, recommendation, review, environment, log, and a new started line are printed before the launch; test of a failed attempt.

title: A failed reroute left the tracked route.json deleted, so the next run was refused for a dirty tree
resolution: routeAgain restores a deleted stale route.json with git checkout HEAD when routing fails or throws, and the refusal says so; the failed-route test asserts the content and a clean tree.

title: A hand-edited headCommit of route.json reached git diff unvalidated and could be read as an option
resolution: A headCommit that is no 40-character hexadecimal commit makes the route stale; test with --output=<file>, which is not written.

title: Codex's reasoning effort and sandbox were reported in its header but not confirmed
resolution: Codex rows report settings: reasoning effort must be the key's variant and sandbox read-only, otherwise exit 4; both are printed as confirmed lines; table and run tests.

title: ROLE was not checked against PASS, so PASS=2 ROLE=A was accepted
resolution: ROLE must be A for passes 1 and 3 and B for pass 2 (governance policy version 5), otherwise exit 2 with the usage; two cases in the arguments test.

title: A prompt that starts with a dash was parsed as an option by Claude Code and OpenCode
resolution: Claude Code and OpenCode take the prompt after --, which both CLIs accepted in a probe without credentials; Antigravity's -p takes it as its value and Codex reads stdin; test for every row.

title: A generic JSON object guard, isRecord, lived in the invocation table module and duplicated isObject of review-route-jev.ts
resolution: isRecord moved to scripts/findings-common.ts, which review-run.ts, reviewer-invocations.ts, and review-route-jev.ts import; isObject is gone. A move without behavior change, covered by the existing tests.

title: The protocol dropped snapshot files from the files kept outside the worktree and did not say who takes the snapshots
resolution: The protocol keeps prompt files, logs, and snapshot files outside the worktree and says that make review takes no snapshot, so the worker takes them before and after it.

title: design.md, proposal.md, and verification.md omitted scripts/review-files.ts after the pass 1 fixes
resolution: design.md names three modules, the proposal's Impact and the verification scope name scripts/review-files.ts and its role.

title: design.md Risks still said that no allowlist ran against a real CLI
resolution: Risks says that passes 1 (Codex) and 2 (Claude Code) ran against the real CLIs and only the Antigravity and OpenCode allowlists stay unchecked.

title: The Stamped tree scenario says route.json is written, but the test's fake route wrote nothing
resolution: The fake route writes route.json on success, and the routing tests assert its content; a failed route writes nothing.

title: The route recommendation output had no test, because every fixture route had empty passes
resolution: The recommendation test covers a match, an effort-only difference for passes 2 and 3, and another reviewer A and B, with the pass 3 to pass 1 mapping.

title: A rejected reroute restored the stale route.json but escaped runReview instead of refusing with exit 1
resolution: A rejected route counts as a failed one: the stale route.json is restored and the pass is refused with exit 1 saying so; a new test covers the rejection.
